## ⚡ Who We Are

**TeamArchon** is an independent development team focused on creating
powerful, modern and reliable open-source software.

We love turning ideas into real projects — from **Telegram bots and
music systems** to developer tools, automation and experimental technology.

> **Think different. Build better. Ship faster.**
